decisions.reason: Grounds in console-split-chunks.txt: entry chunk 200 while sibling imports 404 because siblings were not shipped; browser resolves sibling imports relative to the chunk URL. Proposes single self-contained file via inlineDynamicImports (or ship whole graph with build assertion).

Explicitly compares chunk-route.ts guard with ci-note.md printout: uppercase E: LIB_DIR from URL vs lowercase e: realpath, case-sensitive startsWith rejects a contained file; explains Linux (no case dimension) and laptop (matching lowercase) passes; explicitly rejects 'Windows paths are unreliable'.

Proposes realpathSync both sides + path.relative(base,file), rejecting '..' prefixes and absolute results; realpath resolves symlink escapes; explicitly requires keeping the JavaScript MIME type for dynamic import.

Explains both handlers receive the same bubbling Ctrl+wheel; grants modal exclusive ownership with preventDefault + stopPropagation (passive:false, capture), and pane handler stands down on defaultPrevented/target-in-modal, covering the ancestor-capture case.

Planned checks with expected outcomes for all three incidents: rendered diagram with no 404s and shipped-file existence assertion; case-differing Windows path serves 200 while traversal/encoded/symlink escapes 403; modal zoom fires once with pane font-size unchanged.

caps.reason: Final fix strengthens containment (realpath both sides + path.relative rejecting .. and absolute); no affirmative advice to disable containment or serve outside the resource root.
